FOREWORD
2 ) was adopted by the Indian 1983, after the draft finalized by the had been approved by the Structural

0.1 This Indian Standard ( Part Standards Institution on 18 May Steel Forgings Sectional Committee and Metals Division Council.

0.2 The tolerances for open die steel forgings were earlier covered in when the standard was revised it was IS : 3469-1966+. However, agreed to prepare separate standards covering tolerances for open and closed die steel forgings. Accordingly the following standard covering the tolerances for closed die steel forgings have already been published: IS : 3469 ( Parts 1 to 3 )- 1974 Tolerances ( jirst revision ). 0.3 This standard (Part 2 ) covers forgings made from high alloy steels. to carbon and low alloy steel forgings. for closed die steel forgings

the tolerances for open die steel The other part ( Part 1 ) relates and may

0.4 Additional allowances due to warpage and twist ( circular rectangular ) have not been covered for the present and if required be agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.

0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-19607. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. *Tolerances for steel drop forgings, upset forgings, press forgings and forged bars. $Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised). 3
